style: Palette of near-black, hot crimson, bruise purple and sickly stage-light yellow. Rowdy, comedic and energetic. No band names, logos, banners or lettering anywhere.
notes: Rewrite (2026-10). All five images are new: the old four had a made-up band name painted on, wrestling rings with a real promotion's logo, and a costumed superhero, and the page had no story image. gen Mosh_Pit_Mayhem, then finish Mosh_Pit_Mayhem. Images 2, 3 and 4 were flagged by Klein on the first try (cartoon gore); they were reworded without blood or loose limbs. Image 3 was flagged twice more, so it was made on Nano Banana 2 Lite.

images.prompt: Wide shot at night from the side of a huge outdoor concert stage: a heavy metal band of four long-haired musicians plays under blasting red and purple lights, smoke and sparks, a plain black backdrop behind them. In front of the stage a circular mosh pit has opened in the packed crowd, and a dozen metal fans in black t-shirts, denim vests and leather jackets sprint and slam into each other, bodies flying, while the crowd around the pit throws up horns hand signs. Plain clothing with no prints.

Top-down view looking straight down at a round grey concrete mosh pit ringed by steel crowd barriers and a cheering crowd: eight cartoonish long-haired metal fans in black t-shirts and denim vests run and bump into each other from every direction like bumper cars, one tumbling backwards from a shoulder bump, arms and hair flailing. Long dark skid marks of dirt and old dark-red paint-like stains streak the floor.

Side view action shot inside a mosh pit: a long-haired metal fan in a sleeveless denim vest pushes off a steel crowd barrier with both feet and launches horizontally across the pit at great speed, body twisted so his heavy boots lead the way, toward another surprised metal fan. Speed lines, a puff of dust from the barrier, spinning red stage lights overhead, a cheering crowd blurred behind. No text, lettering or signatures anywhere.

Portrait cover: a burly bearded metalhead with long flying hair leaps joyfully toward the viewer above a churning crowd of moshing fans, fists raised, mouth open in a roar, a concert stage blazing with red and purple lights and smoke far behind him. Dark empty smoky space at the top of the frame.

High wide aerial view at night of an open-air heavy metal festival in a muddy field: three stages blazing with red and purple light, crowds packed in front of each with round mosh pits opened up, rows of camping tents and food trucks between them, and a large white medical tent lit from inside where paramedics stitch up cheerful long-haired fans lying on cots. Dark forest and hills on the horizon.
